gaps.sentence: The plane had no ___ taken off than the captain was forced to turn back.
gaps.explanation: 'No sooner … than' is the fixed pair; here it sits after 'had'.

gaps.sentence: You'd better hurry, ___ you'll miss the flight.
gaps.explanation: 'Otherwise' = if you do not, then this will happen.

gaps.sentence: Hardly ___ he finished speaking when the audience erupted.
gaps.explanation: 'Hardly' at the front inverts the past perfect: Hardly had he finished… when…

gaps.sentence: She speaks English ___ than her brother.
The rescuers worked ___ the night to reach the trapped family.
gaps.explanation: 'Work through the night' = continue working for the whole night.

gaps.sentence: The cat cleans ___ after every meal.
gaps.explanation: Reflexive: the cat cleans ITSELF (the object is the same as the subject).

gaps.sentence: It was ___ a good film that we saw it twice.
